short: Possibly the dog in Eugene Field’s poem The Duel.
note: Possibly the gingham dog in Eugene Field’s The Duel, a children’s poem about a quarrel between a cloth dog and a calico cat, witnessed by a Chinese plate and a Dutch clock.

short: Possibly the cat in Eugene Field’s poem The Duel.
note: Possibly the calico cat in Eugene Field’s The Duel, a children’s poem about two cloth animals whose midnight quarrel becomes a destructive fight.

short: A ballet balance leaning forward with one leg raised behind.
note: An arabesque in which the dancer inclines the torso forward as the extended back leg rises. French penché means leaning or inclined.
